- **Module Quizzes (15%)**: There is a short quiz at the end of each module week. Quizzes cover material from that week only. The lowest quiz score will be dropped.
- **Case Study (25%)**: The case study is graded on coverage analysis, estimation accuracy, negotiation plan quality, and the final report. Both partners receive the same grade unless the peer evaluation form indicates a significant imbalance in contribution.
- **Recorded Statement Exercise (10%)**: The recorded statement exercise is graded on statement structure, question technique, and documentation. You will receive individual feedback from J. Chen within one week of submission.
- **File Audit Practice (10%)**: The file audit practice is graded on completeness and accuracy. The **File Audit Scoring Guide** is the reference for this component. A copy is available in the portal under Course Materials.
- **Final Practical Evaluation (30%)**: The final practical evaluation is a two-part assessment held during week 12. Part 1 covers investigation and statement taking. Part 2 covers estimation and negotiation. You must pass both parts to pass the evaluation. The evaluation is graded against the **File Audit Scoring Guide** and the **Negotiation Scoring Guide**.
